summary.text: Kevin Schwertfeger is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 114 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Schwertfeger earned an associate degree in agriculture from Hutchinson Community College in 1989 and a bachelor's degree in crop protection/pest science and management from Kansas State University in 1992.
His career experience includes working as an independent crop consultant and cattleman.
Schwertfeger took office representing Kansas House District 114 on January 13, 2025, succeeding Michael Murphy.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Corrections and Juvenile Justice Committee, the House Federal and State Affairs Committee and the K-12 Education Budget Committee.
